scenario: A photo editor app bundles an ad SDK with no other unusual indicators.

supported_findings: The app requests storage read/write consistent with a photo-editing function.
Strings reference a bundled ad SDK (com.adnetwork.sdk.banner), and the app connected once to a matching ad CDN domain.
The permission set, strings, and network activity are all consistent with the app's stated function plus routine ad monetization; no findings in this case indicate behavior beyond that.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that this app is malicious, spyware, or otherwise high-risk -- this case's evidence is consistent with an ordinary ad-supported utility app.
Any claim of contact, location, or SMS data exposure -- no such permissions are present.
